verdict.rationale: Inline image display via a terminal graphics protocol is a fair capability to ask of a terminal emulator, but nothing in the evidence pack documents Alacritty supporting Sixel, the Kitty graphics protocol, iTerm2 inline images, or any similar protocol. The built-in box-drawing glyph font is an adjacent rendering feature, not image or graphics protocol support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can display inline images and rich graphics via a documented terminal graphics protocol
